notes: Identity verified from supplied canonical text: The Local-Ladder Effect: Social Status and Subjective Well-Being; Cameron Anderson, Michael W. Kraus, Adam D. Galinsky, and Dacher Keltner; DOI 10.1177/0956797611434537. This is the full primary research article in an OnlineFirst version (pp. 1–8), including four studies and references, rather than an abstract, secondary report, or preregistration. No PDF was supplied. Only n_o is assigned; other fields are placeholders. The identified high-versus-low sociometric-status SWB comparison reports t(115) = 3.05, p = .003, but no analytic participant count or final counts for the two sociometric-status groups. The Method reports 228 recruited across the sociometric and socioeconomic conditions together. That recruitment total is not the analytic N for this two-condition contrast. No N is inferred from degrees of freedom. The printed t(115) is retained as test-identifying evidence only, not as a basis for deriving N.
